biggest_catch: The catalog's RapidWorkers — the microtask platform launched in 2009 at rapidworkers.com — is dead: the site returns 404s as of September 2026 and independent reviewers report it has closed. Do not send users there.
catches: rapidworkers.com returns HTTP 404 on recent status checks (Sept 2026) and reviewer paidfromsurveys.com reports 'RapidWorkers has closed' after months of downtime.

The currently live rapidworkers.net explicitly describes itself as 'a distinct platform' from RapidWorkers — it is not the same company and cannot serve as the official source for the catalog's provider.
Historical third-party reviews described per-task pay of cents ($0.02-$0.50 typical), an $8 minimum payout, and a 6% withdrawal fee — but these describe a defunct site.
Complaint boards show recurring reports of banned accounts and unpaid withdrawals from the old platform.

c1.evidence: The catalog's provider — RapidWorkers at rapidworkers.com (est. 2009) — is defunct: 404s on current status checks and multiple reviewers report closure. The live rapidworkers.net states it is 'a distinct platform,' not this company.

c2.evidence: No concrete payout terms published by the operating company — the company no longer operates; historical figures ($8 minimum, per-task cents) come only from third-party reviews of the dead site.

c3.evidence: Historically free to join per third-party reviews; moot — the site is closed.

c4.evidence: No official source obtainable: rapidworkers.com is dead and rapidworkers.net is explicitly a different platform.

eligibility: None — the platform is closed; do not attempt to join.
notes: Rejected per the strict checklist: c1, c2, c4 all fail. This is a clean defunct-company reject, not a judgment on microtasking. If the catalog intends the distinct rapidworkers.net platform instead, that would be a different provider requiring its own fresh verification (its FAQ claims a $5 minimum withdrawal, but its relationship to the catalog entry is unconfirmed). Do not re-verify R0217 without confirming which entity the catalog means.
